purpose: Define the minimum evidence and mapping rules required before a plant-side propagation/buffering filter can be encoded or empirically promoted in the island-pollination ABM. The interface applies to any island system and prevents post-hoc mechanism rescue.

autonomous_reproductive_assurance.primary_signature: low effective service can coexist with maintained reproductive performance when autonomous reproduction is high; the same buffer should weaken where autonomous assurance is low
autonomous_reproductive_assurance.minimum_direct_measurement: pollinator exclusion or otherwise controlled autonomous reproduction relative to an explicit reproductive-capacity denominator such as supplemental outcross

service_redundancy_or_compensatory_abund.primary_signature: pollinator composition or functional exposure can change while directly measured effective service remains maintained because alternative visitors compensate in rate and/or per-visit effectiveness
service_redundancy_or_compensatory_abund.minimum_direct_measurement: visitor-specific or group-specific visit rate plus direct per-visit effectiveness, combined on the same service scale

resource_or_demographic_compensation.primary_signature: a directly measured post-interaction resource or demographic process compensates for an upstream service or damage deficit and predicts maintained reproductive output after assurance and direct service are measured
resource_or_demographic_compensation.minimum_direct_measurement: manipulated or naturally contrasted resource/demographic response linked to reproductive output in the same units, with direct service and autonomous assurance measured or otherwise separated

colonization_or_establishment_filtering.primary_signature: island trait or assurance differences occur without a current service deficit and covary with independently measured colonization, establishment, or survivorship history rather than being inferred from present pollinator shortage
colonization_or_establishment_filtering.minimum_direct_measurement: independent colonization/establishment contrast or temporal history plus current service and reproductive-assurance measurements

network_context_or_rewiring.primary_signature: the same or similar upstream functional environment yields different realized service because interaction support/partner identity differs, and this difference predicts downstream propagation state
network_context_or_rewiring.minimum_direct_measurement: network or interaction support plus direct effectiveness/service in matched units

admission_states.candidate_only_no_abm_admission: A biologically plausible or source-supported candidate exists, but one or more matched evidence links or pre-outcome mapping requirements are missing.
admission_states.mapping_ready_for_heldout_test: All direct evidence and mapping prerequisites are satisfied and the target outcome was not used to choose the mechanism or parameter mapping; a held-out or prospectively declared test may now be run.
admission_states.failed_predeclared_test_no_admission: A mapping-ready candidate failed its predeclared held-out test. Preserve the failure and do not retune it on the same target.
admission_states.empirically_supported_mechanism_admissio: A predeclared mapping passed a held-out/prospective test after all structural prerequisites were satisfied. This admits the mechanism for the declared scope only, not as a universal island law.

required_before_test: expected direction or qualitative signature frozen
mapping from source measurement to ABM component frozen
parameter or state value derivation rule frozen
target outcome excluded from mapping choice
successful_test_does_not_imply: validity outside the tested mechanism and system scope

next_gate: Use this interface for every future source-triggered or prospective buffer candidate. Do not add a new ABM buffer component until a candidate reaches mapping_ready_for_heldout_test, and do not call it empirically supported until the frozen held-out test passes.
claim_boundary: This interface governs mechanism admission and falsification. It does not itself identify a buffer, estimate a parameter, or make heterogeneous island systems quantitatively commensurate.
